summary: Build 17 VaultPop admin handoff + in-app Admin Console verified end-to-end on the preview mirror (mobile viewport 375x667). BACKEND (pytest 6/6 pass, /app/backend/tests/test_build17_handoff.py, junit: build17_results.xml): POST /api/v1/admin/handoff -> 201 with admin bearer (returns {code, expiresInSeconds}); -> 403 with player bearer; -> 403 with no auth. GET /api/admin/handoff?code=<c> -> 200 HTML containing 'Admin session handoff accepted' the first time; replay of same code -> 403; unknown code -> 403. Single-use + short-lived (60s TTL) behavior confirmed. FRONTEND: (1) Admin (qa.owner.b15@vaultpop.test) on /account shows 'Owner account' + OWNER TOOLS eyebrow + testID account-admin-console-button; clicking it navigates IN-APP to /admin-console (URL: /admin-console, not external); the screen renders 'Admin Console' title with testID admin-console-open-button and no admin-console-error. (2) Admin on /settings shows testID settings-admin-console-button; clicking it navigates in-app to /admin-console. (3) Player (qa.player@vaultpop.app) sees 'Player account' + zero OWNER TOOLS / zero account-admin-console-button / zero settings-admin-console-button; visiting /admin-console directly renders the RESTRICTED view with testID admin-console-restricted-account-link and NO admin-console-open-button (i.e. no session/handoff attempted). (4) Shop VaultPass hero shows disabled 'Currently Unavailable' button + testID shop-vaultpass-unavailable caption ('VaultPass is unavailable right now. Please try again later.') + testID shop-catalog-retry-button (pressing it re-runs load and stays on the unavailable state — no crash). While admin: testID shop-vaultpass-diagnostics is present and contains 'app.vaultpop.vaultpass.monthly' (full text: 'Requested app.vaultpop.vaultpass.monthly — store session unavailable (StoreKit requires a native iOS build).'). While player: shop-vaultpass-diagnostics is NOT rendered. (5) Regression: DAILY REWARDS, BOOSTER FORGE (5 matches), and COIN PACKS all render; account-refresh-button on /account produced 'Account synced.' status pill for the player; sign-out + sign-in flow works. WebView-based in-app admin console is native-only (iOS/android) by design; on web preview the intended browser-tab fallback button is shown — CORRECT behavior per the review request note.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning still fires: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking, previously reported in iteration_6.
Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported ... Falling back to JS-based animation.' Expected on web (no RCTAnimation module). Non-blocking; native builds use RCTAnimation.

action_items: No functional fixes required — every Build 17 acceptance criterion (handoff 201/403/403, single-use consume 200 then 403, in-app /admin-console navigation from both /account and /settings, RESTRICTED gating for players, shop VaultPass fallback + admin-only diagnostics containing app.vaultpop.vaultpass.monthly, DAILY/BOOSTER/COIN sections, Account Sync 'Account synced.', safe forgot-password) is green.
(Carry-over from iteration 6) Optional cleanup: migrate legacy `pointerEvents` prop usages to `style.pointerEvents` to silence deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py admin_handoff (line 319-329) correctly checks role == 'admin' and returns 403 for player/anonymous; codes are 64 hex chars, TTL 60s, stored in an in-memory dict — acceptable for preview mirror.
backend/server.py admin_handoff_consume (line 332-348) uses dict.pop() to enforce single-use semantics and additionally re-checks expiresAt — correct.
account-service.ts requestAdminConsoleHandoffUrl builds the URL from API_BASE_URL + code (no session token in URL) — matches the security requirement stated in the review request.

admin-console-screen.tsx correctly renders RESTRICTED view when profile.account.role !== 'admin' and skips both startSession() and the WebView import — no session/handoff request is fired for non-admins (verified by DOM: no admin-console-open-button in restricted view).
shop-screen.tsx diagnostics gated by profile.account.role === 'admin' && catalogDiag — admin sees it, player does not (verified). Diagnostic text includes product id and StoreKit-native explanation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 acceptance checkpoints — admin flow /account, admin /settings, player negative gating including /admin-console RESTRICTED, shop VaultPass fallback + retry, admin diagnostics visible with product id, player diagnostics hidden, DAILY/BOOSTER/COIN sections, Account Sync)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://vaultpop-premium.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend handoff endpoints live at: POST /api/v1/admin/handoff (admin bearer, returns {code, expiresInSeconds=60}) and GET /api/admin/handoff?code=<> (HTML 200 accepted first call, 403 on replay). testID inventory on /account when signed-out: account-mode-signin, account-mode-create, account-email-input, account-password-input, account-signin-button, account-forgot-password. When signed-in: status-pill, account-refresh-button (this is Account Sync — NOT called account-sync-button), account-signout-button. Admin-only extras: account-admin-console-button. Settings admin extra: settings-admin-console-button. /admin-console admin testIDs: admin-console-open-button (web fallback), admin-console-retry-button (only on error), admin-console-error (only on error). /admin-console non-admin testID: admin-console-restricted-account-link. Shop testIDs: shop-vaultpass-unavailable, shop-catalog-retry-button, shop-vaultpass-diagnostics (admin only), shop-buy-<productId>. Do NOT click the actual Open Admin Console button on web preview during automation — it opens an external tab (browser fallback) which is out of scope. Native WebView admin console cannot be exercised on web preview.
